sentences.ar: جحا وابنه راحوا عالسوق والحمار معهم.
sentences.en: Juha and his son went to the market with the donkey.
Juha was riding and the boy was walking.

sentences.ar: ناس بالطريق حكوا: شوف الأب راكب.
sentences.en: People on the road said: look, the father is riding.
And his son is walking, tired.
So Juha got down and put his son on.

sentences.ar: ناس تانيين حكوا: شوف الولد راكب.
sentences.en: Other people said: look, the boy is riding.
And his father is old and walking.
So the two of them rode together.

sentences.ar: وناس تانيين حكوا: مساكين، الحمار تعب.
sentences.en: And other people said: poor thing, the donkey is tired.
In the end they both got down and walked.

sentences.ar: قال جحا لابنه: مهما تعمل، في حدا رح يحكي.
sentences.en: Juha said to his son: whatever you do, someone will talk.
